{{Quote|I just like to fix things. The more of a challenge, the better. Speeders, blasters, droids... you name it, I've probably taken it apart and put it back together. '''Ora Jaffchee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="Encounter" />
